item.title: Securing File Sharing: Implementing RBAC and JIT Provisioning with Keycloak and Nextcloud
item.description: Discover how to implement tight, automated role-based access control (RBAC). This hands-on guide walks through interconnecting Keycloak and Nextcloud via the Social Login app, passing the 'groups' claim, and Just-In-Time (JIT) provisioning to dynamically partition team folders.
